notes.title: What's next for this game, also a dog.
notes.notes:
Hey friends,

I've had a couple of messages asking about the future of Don't Mess Up, so it's about time that I talk about it. First of, you may notice that I removed the May 20th release date. I never intended it to be public or to release it then. That was a mistake on my end to not update it or hide it. 

I've been very busy with a lot of amazing work for great clients, though you probably won't care about that. I'm also working on my next game, and hopefully you will care about that. I've also been traveling around for work, and, well not sure if there is a reason to care but hey, think what you want.

I was hoping to release an update right after CeBIT to fix bugs I encountered there, I just never had the time to put the last coat of paint on it and assumed not many of you cared anyway.

For some reason in the past couple days I've had quite a few people asking for updates and telling me they still play the game. It got my gears turning. I had a few ideas for release but never an actual plan. I think it's time for me to get the game out of limbo and tell everyone what's next.

I have an idea, that the more I think about, the more it makes sense. I'm not quite ready to release, but it's exciting and I can't wait to share with y'all. Let's just say, the game will keep growing, and there will be an actual release, that hopefully contains all the things that I wanted this game to have.

I know it's not much, but I want to make it clear that game isn't dead and that I want it to be released for realsies. I don't know when, I just know how.

Anyway, I don't know how to end this, so here's a low quality picture of my dog:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27457570/8cd387c830d2d88684b7258318fb38fe2e06c6ea.png[/img]

notes.title: Hello from CeBIT!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

This week, I'll be at CeBIT in Germany to talk about the game and VR in general. I have a booth in Hall 17 at the VR Base space!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27457570/a1bedb5992a036cd03314c078d22fa7f4766420d.jpg[/img]

I'll also be giving a talk on Tuesday, March 21st at 11:30 about practical uses for VR beyond gaming. If you're in the area, come say hi!

Warm hugs,

Ivan_

notes.title: Introducing The Golden Update
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27457570/962362dc778f8c791379c04b10ad2a65b73a7230.png[/img]

Featuring two new games and a shower of updates! It's very late and very big, but hopefully very worth it!

Steal some gold from a mildly secure vault, or mine it yourself just like in that one game with all the Lego-looking squares my little nephew plays on his phone! Also engage in very fun activities including, and limited to: listening to music in the menu, not hitting the ball so hard in tennis that it goes through your racket but still makes a noise, and still carefully avoiding shooting the Princess in The Bow and Arrow game. 

 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27485220/08fc1abd24624a89f54b1f95e08ba26a26f405ae.png[/img]



Find out more in the changelog right here: http://steamcommunity.com/games/579970/announcements/detail/233465047945785357

Love,

Ivan_

notes.title: Taking irony to a whole new level
notes.notes:
The demo was shipped last week with the quality thingies being on the lowest possible settings, and all of you are praising this game and being too nice to tell me it looks horrible. I appreciate you looking out for my feelings but I'm going to have trust issues from now on.

The problem should be fixed. It should look a lot better. If it doesn't, please let me know. And speaking of fixes, I also fixed a bug that made some 3 players games never end, and a few other small things here and there.

There is bigger, better update coming soon with more free games just as an apology I swear I haven't been planning it for a long time it's totally to make it up to you okay? Okay.

I know I hurt you and I'll make it better. I hope we can work this out and grow from this experience together.

Graphically-updatedly yours,

Ivan_

notes.title: Oh dang I guess the demo is live or something
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Thanks for checking out Don't Mess Up, I hope you got a chance to give the demo a spin and enjoyed it!

There is a lot more coming very soon so be sure to check the game after each updates because it will get marginally better every time maybe!

Big thanks to everyone for the awesome feedback on various social networks, I'm trying to give everyone some love so keep it coming!

Have a great week end and see you when you see this game updating and don't remember what it is and come to this page to remember why you got it!

Love,

Ivan_
